02 / A little about us

Little questions.
Lifelong curiosity.

Learn With Why is a small studio drawing calm, ink-light sheets for children aged three to eight. Every page is tested at a real kitchen table and in a real classroom before it reaches the shelf.

Curiosity is a muscle. We turn it into a game.

Why we started

We kept printing worksheets that were loud, cluttered and full of clip art. So we drew our own: one idea per page, generous white space, and a question at the bottom that starts with why.

  • Designed with teachers, not stock templates
  • Ink-friendly — a full pack costs pennies to print
  • One purchase, unlimited home printing within your licence

How it works

Pick a sheet or a worksheet, unlock it, and print it at home as many times as your licence allows. Free access sheets need nothing but a printer.

03 / What we do

We turn big ideas into one calm page.

Learn With Why designs, tests and delivers printable sheets for children aged three to eight — alphabet, numbers, colours, shapes, stories and handwriting — so practice at home feels like play.

✎

We design

Every sheet is drawn by hand around a single idea: one letter, one number, one shape. Generous white space, thick guide lines and letterforms small hands can copy.

✓

We test

Early-years teachers try each page in real classrooms before it reaches the shelf. If a four-year-old gets stuck, we redraw it.

⇩

We deliver

Unlock a sheet and print it at home in A4 or US Letter, as many times as your licence allows, for as long as you like.

  • Sheets for daily five-minute practice, worksheets for week-by-week progress.
  • Ink-friendly, black-and-white friendly, tablet friendly.
  • A free access sheet in every subject to try first.

One idea per page. One giggle per sheet. No clip art was harmed.
